James Carter  
San Francisco, CA | (555) 123-4567 | james.carter@email.com | linkedin.com/in/jamescarter | github.com/jamescarter  

A results-oriented backend engineer with 4 years of experience building scalable, secure, and high-performance systems for healthtech platforms. Specialized in microservices architecture, cloud infrastructure, and database optimization, with a proven track record of driving measurable improvements in system reliability, performance, and cost efficiency. Currently leading backend development at HealthTrack Inc., a mid-sized healthtech company with a focus on patient data analytics and telehealth integration.  

At HealthTrack Inc. (2021–present), I’ve designed and maintained a microservices-based architecture that supports over 500,000 daily users, reducing API latency by 30% through optimized service composition and asynchronous processing. I led the migration of the platform to AWS, implementing auto-scaling groups, EC2 fleets, and cost-optimization strategies that cut infrastructure costs by 25% while improving uptime to 99.95%. My work on PostgreSQL performance tuning, including query optimization and index strategy refinement, resulted in a 40% improvement in read throughput for critical analytics modules. I also developed a CI/CD pipeline using GitHub Actions and Docker, enabling automated testing and deployment for 12+ services, reducing release cycles from weeks to days.  

During my tenure as a Junior Backend Developer at MedTech Innovations (2020), I contributed to the development of a HIPAA-compliant patient monitoring platform, focusing on REST API design and Python-based backend services. I implemented Docker containerization for microservices, improving deployment consistency and resource utilization. My work on PostgreSQL query optimization, including schema redesign and connection pooling, reduced database response times by 25% for high-traffic endpoints. I also collaborated on setting up monitoring and alerting with Prometheus and Grafana, enabling real-time visibility into system performance and incident response times.  

As a Software Developer Intern at HealthData Solutions (2019), I supported the development of a data aggregation tool for healthcare providers, focusing on Python-based data processing pipelines. I helped design RESTful APIs for secure data exchange, ensuring compliance with industry standards. My work on CI/CD automation with Jenkins and Docker streamlined the deployment process, reducing manual intervention by 50%.  

Technical expertise includes:  
- **AWS**: Architecting and scaling cloud infrastructure, implementing auto-scaling, and cost-optimization strategies.  
- **Microservices**: Designing and maintaining distributed systems with asynchronous communication and service discovery.  
- **PostgreSQL**: Optimizing query performance, indexing strategies, and database schema design for high-throughput applications.  
- **Python**: Developing core backend services, REST APIs, and data processing pipelines.  
- **CI/CD**: Automating deployments with GitHub Actions, Docker, and Jenkins.  
- **Docker**: Containerizing microservices for consistent environments and improved resource management.  
- **Linux administration**: Managing server infrastructure, configuring firewalls, and monitoring system performance.  
- **Monitoring & alerting**: Implementing Prometheus and Grafana for real-time system visibility.  
- **Terraform**: Automating infrastructure-as-code for cloud resource provisioning and management.  

Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, University of California, Berkeley (2018).
